description: Relevés du suivi du trait de côte par smartphone (tracés GPS pris par Rivages) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Markers of the position of the coastline made by consumer contributors using the participatory smartphone application Rivages developed by Cerema, as part of the National Strategy for Integrated Coastline Management and at the April 2016 Environmental Conference among the measures to "Adapt coastal territories to climate change". Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Tracking of the coastline by smartphone (GPS tracks taken by Rivages)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include rivages, trait de côte, marqueurs gps. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
